stories.headline: Apple’s HomeView Tries Face Authentication Without FaceID
stories.dek: Apple’s FaceID has long provided robust authentication. But for its smart home device, HomeView, the company is betting on new “person recognition” technology that has yet to be challenged in the wild.

stories.headline: Olaf Sakkers is betting he can beat the emerging-manager squeeze
stories.dek: Entering into the world of venture capital has never been easy, especially as a first-time fund manager. But it's especially daunting right now. Olaf Sakkers has spent the past five years proving that difficult doesn't mean impossible.

stories.headline: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
stories.dek: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay up front, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

stories.headline: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech
stories.dek: With the rise of AI agents like Instinct and Muse, the industry needs to rethink human identity on the internet and rely on biometric signals like voice, which is where Helix comes in.
